BusinessLimitPendingTrxn.name: BusinessLimitPendingTrxn
BusinessLimitPendingTrxn.description: Represents transient usage records that reserve a portion of the business limit for a transaction. If the transaction fails, these reserved portions are freed up for future use.

BusinessLimitTrackerId.description: The ID of the business limit tracker associated with this business limit pending transaction.

Name.description: The autogenerated unique number of the record.

RequestKey.description: The unique identifier of the request.

ReservedUsageValue.description: The amount of usage reserved against the limit.

BusinessLimitPendingTrxn.accessRules: BusinessLimitPendingTrxn is only available in orgs where Global Promotions Management is enabled.
